snippet.title: Isle of Reveries: OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Action adventure Isle of Reveries sets flight on all consoles September 4! Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this Zelda-inspired romp.

✨Join the Mailing list for exclusive updates and deals: https://airport.electricairship.com/isle-of-reveries/

✨Wishlist Now on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020559

✨Follow Electric Airship on social media:
https://links.electricairship.com/

Take control of Lief, cunning owl, and set skybound to the forsaken Isle of Reveries! Here, it is said that any wish can be granted. Know this– seven mysterious dungeons lie in wait, each with its own unique themes, puzzles, and combat challenges!  
This epic adventure is coming September 4 to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC! 
EXPLORE A VAST OVERWORLD & CONQUER DUNGEONS: Eight different biomes in the overworld. Seven different dungeons, each with unique themes, mechanics, and key items.
COPY & SPAWN OBJECTS: Use Lief's fairy companion to duplicate and summon a myriad of objects into the world. You’ll discover how they interact with your robust set of tools to solve head-scratching puzzles and terrifying combat encounters. 
FORGE A COMMUNITY: Construct various buildings and forge your township! Charming anthropomorphic friends that Lief rescues throughout the game will move into the settlement, offering new quests and stories.


~Game Details~

Title: Isle of Reveries
Release Date: September 4, 2026
Price: $19.99
Platforms: Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PC
Publisher: Electric Airship
Developer: desertcucco
Genre: Puzzle action-adventure
Players: single player or co-op (post release patch on consoles)
Languages: English + more if possible
Press Contact: contact@electricairship.com 📧
